heroText: I build .NET services across commerce, search, data and operations. My work connects API design with the consistency and reliability of the wider system.
demoLabel: Choose a domain. See its relationships and my work.
initialNode: Catalog, categories and variants connect the customer-facing API with search, cache and source data.
tryFailure: What happens on a cache miss?
workIntro: Three examples of decisions across service boundaries. Explore the problem, my contribution and the resulting behaviour.
caseProductNameOutcome: One manufacturer endpoint, with explicit filtering and pagination contracts.
productProblem: Rich product models make it easy to load more data than a list needs, while category and variant relationships complicate filtering.
productContribution: Manufacturer requests consolidated into one endpoint; category and variant APIs; targeted PostgreSQL projections with filtering, mapping and pagination tests.
productDecision: Keep pagination, filtering and mapping stable while reducing unnecessary reads. Measure runtime gains separately.
resultproduct: The manufacturer flow exposes a consolidated endpoint. Projection changes are checked against filtering, mapping and pagination behaviour; no unmeasured latency gain is claimed.
productContext: Catalog APIs / Relational projections / Search contracts
searchNameOutcome: Category and variant data carried through to searchable product results.
searchProblem: Product changes, category relationships and media updates must reach the search index without losing consistency.
searchContribution: Elasticsearch-backed product search, category population, variant queries, search result counts and media refresh flows.
searchDecision: Follow the whole path: source data, indexing, filters and the result the customer actually sees.
resultsearch: Product search includes category and variant queries, result counts and media refresh paths. Source-data changes and index updates remain separate steps to diagnose.
searchContext: Search behaviour / Indexing workflows / Data consistency
identityNameOutcome: Role-aware administration and Excel exports delivered as a stream.
identityProblem: Administrative workflows join permissions, account data, reporting and large exports across services.
identityContribution: Dashboard count features, multiple-role-code handling, impersonation session management, localised streaming Excel exports and product-request validation.
identityDecision: Make access boundaries explicit and avoid buffering an entire export when a stream can carry the result.
resultidentity: Administrative features include dashboard counts and multiple-role handling. Localised Excel export is streamed instead of assembling the complete file in memory.
dataNameOutcome: Redis pre-checks and more precise cache keys.
dataProblem: A cache entry, relational record and search document represent different versions of the same business fact.
dataContribution: Redis pre-checks for variant queries, manufacturer cache-key improvements, cache invalidation after successful writes, and focused relational projections.
dataDecision: Keep the source of truth explicit. Invalidate after a successful write, and preserve query semantics while reducing unnecessary reads.
casePlatformNameOutcome: Media refresh in queued batches and continuations.
platformProblem: Media processing and scheduled jobs have different execution needs from interactive requests.
platformContribution: Splitting media upload work into Hangfire jobs, resolving scheduled-job execution issues, and investigating failures across service boundaries.
platformDecision: Give background work an explicit lifecycle and diagnosable failures. A retry must respect the operation’s side effects.
platformContext: Background processing / Queue boundaries / Job lifecycle
opsNameOutcome: Timing and traceability across service workflows.
opsProblem: A failed request may start in one service and become visible in another. Understanding the runtime matters as much as reading the code.
opsContribution: Service-level troubleshooting, Elasticsearch and log investigation, background-job diagnostics and work with container and delivery tooling.
opsDecision: Use logs, timing and service state together to narrow down a failure before changing behaviour.
casePaymentNameOutcome: Provider integrations, refunds and reconciliation safeguards.
paymentProblem: Payment providers, order records and ERP documents can disagree after a timeout or a partial refund.
paymentContribution: Payment API integrations, cancellation and refund flows, event-driven state handling, and checks around downstream accounting operations.
paymentDecision: Treat an uncertain provider result explicitly. Reconcile before repeating a financial operation.
paymentContext: Payment providers / Cancellation and refunds / ERP integration
